1. What is Adobe Photoshop?

Adobe Photoshop is one of the most popular and most used applications in the Adobe Creative Cloud.

Photoshop is the best photo editing app for creatives.

It is an excellent tool to have on your device if you wish to edit and compose multiple layers of picture files, graphics, and text.

Adobe Photoshop is a raster graphics editor for Windows and macOS, created and marketed by Adobe Inc.

It was founded in 1988 by Thomas and John Knoll; since then, the software has become the industry standard not only for raster graphics editing but also for digital art in general.

Layering is primarily used to add depth and versatility to photo editing and design methods.

As a result, it offers strong picture editing capabilities that may be used to create spectacular photographs.

If you want to know more about Adobe Photoshop, you can visit the official Adobe Website.

2. Why do you need Photoshop?

Photoshop is widely used by professional photographers as well as other creatives, and it has become a must-have app for them.

Professional creatives consider Photoshop a must-have Adobe application.

In addition to image editing, Photoshop is a full-fledged graphics editor, which many creatives currently prefer over an app.

And if you’re wondering, why do graphic designers and photographers need Photoshop?

The simple answer is that it's because Photoshop is the most powerful app for both creating and enhancing images. ‍

Layers make it simple to develop templates that can be edited and rearranged with one click.

And to give you some of the benefits of using Photoshop for graphic designers and creatives as a whole, here are some points to know:

Uses of Adobe Photoshop

  1. Utilize Photoshop's unique features, tools, and settings to express your creativity.
  2. Design web pages, flyers, posters, business cards, social media posts, logos, and more.
  3. Using Photoshop's clone stamps and healing brushes, you can restore old photos.
  4. Enhance photos with brightening, contrasting, and sharpening tools.
  5. See the software's power in producing eye-catching, professional designs.

PS. If you want to know how to get Adobe Photoshop for free or how to subscribe to its full version, just keep on reading.

3. Download Photoshop for Free

Since I’ve already provided you with some of the uses and great features of Adobe Photoshop, the next question in your mind might be this:

How to download Adobe Photoshop full version for free?

Just so you know, you can download Adobe Photoshop for free as a trial for seven days—and here’s how.

The first thing that you must do to be able to get Photoshop for free is to visit the official website of Adobe.

As soon as you are on the website, you’ll see two options, which are "Free Trial" and "Buy Now".

But since you wanted to try and explore Adobe Photoshop for free, go ahead and hit the "Free Trial" button.

After that, you’ll be able to select your desired plan—for individuals, for students, and for businesses.

You will be asked to create your Adobe ID and input your payment details, but don’t worry because as long as you cancel your account before the free trial expires, you won’t be charged.‍

Although you don’t have to pay anything, you’ll be able to enjoy the full version of the software, which includes all the features and updates in the latest version of Photoshop.

Given this feature, you can play around with the full version of the software to see if it meets your requirements, and if so, you can continue your subscription.

Try Adobe Photoshop 7-Day Free Trial now

4. How To Buy Photoshop

Once the 7-day free trial has ended and you’ve enjoyed the features and uses of Photoshop, you can buy a Creative Cloud Membership.

Creative Cloud offers various plans with different prices to choose from.

Purchasing a monthly or annual subscription is the best way to continue to have access to the full version of Adobe Photoshop after the free trial.

As you can see in the image above, Adobe CC is offering its users a variety of choices to choose from.

Basically, if you’re looking for the cheapest way to buy Photoshop, you would probably consider the Photography Plan (20GB), which costs $9.99/month.

It includes the Photoshop app for desktop and iPad, Lightroom for desktop and mobile, Lightroom Classic, Adobe Portfolio, Fonts, and Spark.

Take note that the Photography Plan is also available in 1 TB and you can get that for only $19.99/month.

However, if you want to have the best plan for creating beautiful graphics, photos, and art for desktop and iPad, I would suggest the Photoshop Plan.

It costs $20.99/month and it comes with Photoshop on desktop and iPad, 100GB of cloud storage, Adobe Fresco, Portfolio, Fonts, and access to the latest features and updates as soon as they’re released.

Lastly, the best option is to get the Creative Cloud All Apps package—you’ll be able to enjoy all the Adobe apps and you can save a lot of money by not buying a subscription individually.

It only costs $52.99 and it is absolutely perfect for creatives that need other Adobe software aside from Photoshop.

6. Photoshop for Android & iOS

If you're an on-the-go creative, you'll most likely want to have access to Adobe Photoshop using only your mobile phone and iPad.

How to install Adobe Photoshop for smartphones and iPads?

Adobe Creative Cloud has a lot of apps for Android and iOS that you can download to your smartphone or tablet.

Some of the apps that you can install on your devices are Adobe Photoshop Express, Photoshop Mix, Photoshop Sketch, Lightroom Mobile, and Photoshop Fix.

And to give you an idea of how these apps work, here’s a short description for each:

  • Photoshop Express - free image editing and collage making mobile application from Adobe Inc which is available on iOS, Android and Windows phones and tablets.
  • Photoshop Mix - photo-editing app that, among many other things, lets you put two photos together to create one spectacular image.
  • Photoshop Sketch - drawing app that offers you loads of useful tools—pencils, fountain pens, markers, erasers, acrylics, ink brushes, pastels, splash colors, etc.
  • Lightroom Mobile - free, powerful photo editor and camera app that empowers your photography, helping you capture and edit stunning images.
  • Photoshop Fix - enables powerful, yet easy image retouching and restoration on your Android and iOS phones, as well as on your tablets and iPads.


These apps give you access to unique Photoshop tools while you're on the go, so you can edit, create, and share photos at any time and from any place.

And do you want to know what the best thing about this Adobe mobile software is? They are ALL FREE to download.‍

You just have to search for and find these Adobe Photoshop mobile versions on your Playstore or Appstore and then simply hit the download button.

What are you waiting for? Try this Adobe Photoshop app on your mobile devices and iPads for free!

7. Photoshop Alternatives

Although Adobe Photoshop is considered the best creative application for editing photos, there are also alternatives that you can find online.

What are the best alternatives to Adobe Photoshop?

While some are better than others, not every app is capable of helping you create incredible works of art or edit your photos.

Canva, Procreate, Affinity Photo, CoreIDRAW, GIMP, Sketch, Pixelmator Pro, Lumiar AI, Fotor, and Photopea are some of the apps that you can use instead of Photoshop.‍

Some of these Photoshop alternatives are 100% free, while others require a payment, but at an affordable price.

As a graphic designer, you have the option to consider using these alternatives, but I recommend that you stick with Photoshop.

‍Adobe Photoshop covers almost everything that a creative needs for a photo editing application.

And if you’re worrying about the monthly subscription fee, just remember that you can get the Photoshop mobile versions for free.‍

So if you’re looking for the best application for editing images, Adobe Photoshop is absolutely the best option for you.

Conclusions

Photoshop is one of the best and most popular Adobe applications for all kinds of creatives, especially photographers and graphic designers.

‍Adobe Photoshop is available for free (7-day trial) to creatives who want to experiment with its features.

You don’t have to pay for the first 7 days, but if you enjoy it and decide to continue using it, you can buy an Adobe CC membership.‍

You’ll have different options to choose from depending on your needs and budget as well.

Don’t worry because whatever Photoshop plan you choose, Adobe CC has discounts to offer you, so you can save a lot.

Take note that this photo-editing app is not only available for desktops; you can also install Photoshop on your smartphones, tablets, or iPads.‍

I hope this article answers all your questions about how you can download Photoshop for free, as well as other necessary things about the app.
